title: Graph-based pan-genome reveals structural variations associated with agronomic traits in mung bean.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Downloaded and opened the Supplementary Tables workbook (36 sheets, 2.1 MB) and all 7 Source Data workbooks; Table S1 lists 580 accessions (all 'Used for GWAS'), Table S19 lists 20 trait names only. No sheet holds per-accession phenotype values; source data give only boxplot summaries (min/quartiles/max). Zenodo 19186411 is a 19 KB code zip (CC-BY-4.0); GitHub repo holds only run.sh scripts. NCBI SRA search: 582 runs under PRJNA1161446, 103 under PRJNA1160184 (raw reads).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Five field environments, the 66,862 structural variants and 75,268 gene families, and the VrTIFY6B / VrPGIP1 functional results come from the abstract and data availability text; no genotype matrix (VCF, variant call file) was found deposited, which I inferred from the availability statement listing only raw reads and assemblies.

a1_downloadable.note: Supplementary and source-data xlsx files and raw reads download openly; verified in files.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No per-accession trait values in any released table (checked all 36 supplementary sheets and 7 source-data files); only trait names and boxplot summaries. The label does not exist in the download.

a3_inputs_present.note: Genotypes are only raw whole-genome reads for 580 accessions (582 SRA runs); no SNP or structural-variant genotype matrix released, so inputs would need full variant calling.

a4_units_stated.note: Not assessable: no phenotype table released.

a5_enough_rows.note: 580 accessions (Table S1, verified) is below the 1,500 regression threshold even if phenotypes existed.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: raw resequencing reads for 580 accessions, likely terabytes (size not checked)
a6_fits_laptop.note: Building a genotype matrix from raw reads needs alignment and variant calling, far beyond a laptop.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: 580 accessions in Table S1 matches the paper; 582 SRA runs is close (possibly extra runs).

a8_label_provenance.note: Traits would be field measurements, but none are released.

existing_models.name: GBLUP genomic prediction in mungbean seed traits (Boddepalli et al. 2026, The Plant Genome)
existing_models.score_and_split: Prediction accuracy r = 0.76-0.84 for seed size and weight (from search snippet; split not checked)

backbone.name: none suitable; plant DNA language models (e.g. AgroNT) exist but genotype matrix is not released
backbone.licence: Code CC-BY-4.0; data terms of NGDC/NCBI

honest_claim_h3: Not reachable: without per-accession phenotypes and a genotype matrix, no model can be trained on this release.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use DNA differences across 580 mung bean lines, including large insertions and deletions, to predict field traits like seed weight and flowering time.
plain_idea.train_on: Genotypes (single-letter and structural DNA differences) for each of 580 accessions; phenotype values not released, so usable examples: 0.
plain_idea.predict: Field-measured traits (20 traits, five environments) such as 100-grain weight and days to flowering, recorded by the authors' field teams.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would test whether structural variants improve genomic prediction over single-letter variants in an orphan legume crop, useful to mung bean breeders.

ml_idea: Genomic prediction of 20 agronomic traits from SNP plus structural-variant genotypes, testing whether structural variants add accuracy; blocked because neither phenotypes nor genotype calls are released.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; data needed for the task is not released.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already done: searched all 36 supplementary sheets and 7 source-data files for per-accession trait values; none present.

verdict_reason: Fails A2 and A3, verified in files: no per-accession phenotype table and no genotype matrix are released, only raw reads and summary boxplots; 580 accessions is also below the A5 threshold.
